text:
Casey: dropped a compact dashboard tweak in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/aaaaaa (frame: compact-timepicker-sampler). Looking for quick takes on: (1) the new time-presets dropdown (compact vs full), (2) we added a tiny sampling slider under the heatmap, label choices?, (3) animation when switching presets (smooth zoom vs instant snap), and (4) how to surface sample size + p95 clarity in tiny rows.

Noor: first pass  presets: compact mode should show icons + short labels (1h, 6h, 7d) instead of full names. full mode keeps descriptive names. We should preserve keyboard shortcuts for preset quick-select (numbers 1-6).

Diego: sampling slider is great but worried about discoverability. maybe replace lone slider with a combined control: a small icon + popover that shows slider + numeric input. label: `Sampling granularity` > tooltip: `Higher granularity increases accuracy and cost`.

Alex: on animation: avoid long easing when jumping between distant ranges. recommend micro-transitions for <12h changes (scale+translate) and immediate repaint for >=12h. add a 150ms fade-in for the new buckets to reduce flicker.

Maya: how do we show sample size in tiny rows? current idea: show `n=23` inline next to p95 when there's space; otherwise expose it in tooltip on hover/focus. also suggest a `low sample` micro-pill when n < 30.

Casey: copy alternatives to test: `Sampling`, `Sampling rate`, `Sampling granularity`, `Sample size (n)`. Which one is clearest to non-infra folks?

Noor: avoid `rate` unless it's actually rows/sec. `Sampling granularity` is fine; for the panel we can show `Sample size (n)` for the count metric. pair with help text: `Higher granularity => more samples per time window` (short).

Diego: UI nit: the p95 label in the mini-row reads `p95 320ms`. that's terse but maybe ambiguous. Suggest `95th pct: 320 ms` or `95th %ile: 320 ms`. I prefer `95th pct` (short but clearer to product folks).

Alex: accessibility: controls need aria-labels and keyboard focus. presets menu should be a listbox with aria-activedescendant, sampling slider should expose aria-valuenow + aria-valuetext like `Sampling granularity: medium (approx +/- X% accuracy)`. also put aria-live polite for sampling updates: `Sampling updated, results may be approximate`.

Maya: animation accessibility concern: motion-sensitive users should be able to disable transitions. we already have a reduce-motion setting at account level; make sure the preset switch respects it.

DesignerBot: accessibility scan results:
- Contrast: small text `n=23` on semi-opaque chip (#ffffff on rgba(0,0,0,0.6)) passes 4.5:1 at 12px.
- Motion: recommended to keep any zoom/scale animation under 200ms and provide `prefers-reduced-motion` fallback.
- Screen reader: prefer announcing `p95: 320 milliseconds, sample size 23, sampled` rather than terse inline tokens.

Casey: performance note: rendering slider for every row will be heavy. plan is one global sampling control per panel that affects the visible rows, plus a per-row badge for `n=` and `low sample`.

Noor: pattern alternative for colorblind users: offer hatched overlay for top bucket or high-density mode toggle. also add a legend mini-toggle that can change between `color`/`pattern`.

Diego: CSS snippet for tiny pill + focus rules:
```
.pill { font-size: 11px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(250,250,250,0.9); }
.pill:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37,99,235,0.18); outline: none; }
@media (max-width: 380px) { .p95-label { display: inline-block; max-width: 60px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } }
```

Maya: decision proposal:
1) use `Sampling granularity` as control label, keep `Sample size (n)` for counts
2) compact presets show icons + short labels; full presets show descriptive names
3) animation: micro-transitions <12h, instant >=12h + 150ms fade for buckets
4) show inline `n=` when space, otherwise tooltip; always show `low sample` pill when n < 30
5) add pattern toggle for colorblind mode and respect `prefers-reduced-motion`

Alex: +1. add a single a11y test case to QA: screen reader flow for focusing a row and reading `95th pct` + `n=` + sampling status.

Noor: please also include a short microcopy for the sampling popover: `Higher granularity = more accurate percentiles, increased compute`. keep it under 80 chars.

Casey: great. i'll update the figma with these changes and push a new frame (compact-timepicker-sampler-v2). will tag folks when ready. :rocket:
